scope: assemble one bounded 140-DOF scalar operator from the pinned local-front MLS provider; no solver, boundary load, or crack-face load

geometry.volume_integration_domain: full box; the finite crack surface has zero volume measure and is split as a branch interface
geometry.crack_plane_queries: none; all Gauss samples lie strictly inside a signed-y half-box
geometry.front_queries: none; x and y Gauss samples lie strictly inside signed half-intervals

provider.evaluation_protocol: sample_at(query_index) in frozen quadrature order; each OK sample must carry registry.canonical_ids in exactly the same order as its contributions

source_roles_and_dofs.semantic_order: the frozen DofRegistry canonical order, sorted by source ID, field component, basis kind, and basis index; every K, row, and probe vector uses this order

material_and_scalar_model.bilinear_form: K_ab = integral_Omega mu * grad(N_a) dot grad(N_b) dV
material_and_scalar_model.z_gradient_coefficient: mu, as required by this scalar Poisson bridge
material_and_scalar_model.full_3d_difference: the scalar mu coefficient on dUz/dz is not the full 3-D isotropic epsilon_zz coefficient lambda+2*mu

quadrature.rule: four signed xy quadrants, each tensor-product GL4 x GL4 x GL4
quadrature.crack_plane_split: y=0 separates positive and negative sides; interior Gauss nodes do not sample the interface
quadrature.front_split: x=0 also separates the xy quadrants; no point is shifted or clipped
quadrature.integration_accuracy_boundary: GL4 is exact for one-dimensional polynomials through degree 7, but MLS/enrichment products and front gradients are not polynomial; this single split rule has no convergence or singular-integration qualification
quadrature.front_core_handling: no radial hole or cutoff; positive quadrature points may be inside the 1 mm front core while remaining off the exact front

support_coverage.claim: the complete box is geometrically within h of at least one source
support_coverage.actual_support_cardinality: not assumed from the geometric coverage bound; record the real per-query MLS support counts
support_coverage.polynomial_rank_conditioning_and_mls_sta: unknown until a separately authorized diagnostic run

constant_translation.coefficient_rule: BASE coefficients=1 m; all HEAVISIDE and FRONT_F1_SHIFTED coefficients=0 m
constant_translation.interpretation: one scalar antiplane constant translation only; not six vector rigid modes

affine_base_patch.coefficient_rule: BASE coefficient at source i equals x_i in m; all enriched coefficients=0 m
affine_base_patch.purpose: linear MLS BASE-space patch and fixed-volume integration diagnostic

volume_mean.semantic_order: same canonical 140-entry DofRegistry order as K

limitations: this is a scalar antiplane Poisson bridge, not full 3-D isotropic elasticity
the original Mode III analytic coefficient pattern is not exact over this local finite-PU space and is not used as a global exact field
the BASE affine patch is a bounded diagnostic and does not qualify local-front enrichment or convergence
the fixed GL4 split rule is a single diagnostic rule and does not establish integration convergence near the front
geometric support coverage does not prove MLS polynomial rank or conditioning
no displacement constraints, reactions, traction, solver, crack growth, or SIF calculation
